draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.42, the 16th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 2nd of 31 at WR. He went 23rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Chris Olave. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (97th percentile), 10-yard split (88th percentile). College production: 987 receiving yards in 2024, 10th of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers. 14 career games and 5 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: drop rate 2.3% (82nd percentile). Weak spots: receiving td 0 (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 wide receiver who played: 361 receiving yards against a median of 198, above the norm.
